statistics.dispersion: sample standard deviation with denominator n-1
statistics.worstCaseDecisionLatency: maximum repeated-run p95 scheduling decision latency
statistics.worstCaseOccupiedWorkers: maximum repeated-run max workload-occupied worker count

interpretationBoundaries: Custom policy decision-latency aggregates are based on high-resolution scheduler decision annotations.
Default kube-scheduler has no comparable high-resolution decision timestamp and therefore has no decision-latency aggregate in these outputs.
Common placement comparisons use completion, unschedulable count, maximum workload-occupied workers, dominant requested-load variance, and CPU-memory imbalance.

The aggregate sample standard deviation pools nine workload-level repetitions and therefore combines between-workload and within-workload variation; workload-level rows should be used for per-regime uncertainty.
